tutorial.html:
Go Fish (Declarative)

Ask another player for a rank that you hold. Collected sets of four become books. If they have none, draw from the deck; the most books wins.

Choose a rank and opponent from the offered Ask buttons. Your hand and completed books are shown, while other hands stay hidden.
